messages:
deploybot: Heads-up: scheduled deploy window at 23:00 UTC for release v3.7.2. We're toggling the feature flag `heartbeat_mode` in a staggered release. Plan: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100% with ~5m holdpoints and automated health checks. Pin image to sha256:abc123. Rollback triggers: 5xx rate > 0.5% OR latency p95 > 250ms sustained for 2m. Starting prep now. :eyes:
jen: Confirming window — we good for the 23:00 change window? I'll update release notes and ping legal for the data-export blurb.
devin: Yep from infra side. Autoscaler warmup set to 5m. I already set the pin in deploy config: `image: service:v3.7.2@sha256:abc123`.
samir: Monitoring dashboards: /dashboards/route/heartbeat-latency. I'll watch p50/p95, error budget, and traces. Can we include an internal-only traffic slice for the first canary?
maria: Suggest starting at 0.5% not 1% for the first step to reduce noise. Also recommend turning KV cache snapshot retention OFF during first two steps to avoid cache stampede.
deploybot: Noted. Updated plan: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100%. Holdpoints 5m each. Canary cohort = internal-only + 10% of beta cohort. KV retention: OFF for first 10m. :thumbsup:
qa-bot: preflight checks passed: integration smoke ok, e2e queue < 5s, canary logs show no ERROR. build artifact artifact://v3.7.2 verified.
jen: Release notes draft: 'heartbeat_mode: opt-in gradual rollout to improve routing resiliency. Rollback safe within the change window. See internal runbook for recovery steps.' I'll post to #release-notes now.
devin: quick ops API snippet to flip flag if needed (one-liner):
```
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/toggle \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
 -d '{"flag":"heartbeat_mode","percent":5,"comment":"canary step"}'
```
samir: If we need to rollback fast, use: `curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/toggle -d '{"flag":"heartbeat_mode","percent":0}'` and then `kubectl rollout restart deploy/service --namespace=prod` to drain sessions. Ops will assist.
ops-bot: Reminder: maintenance window locked 23:00-01:00 UTC. Alerts escalations to #oncall if SLO breach > 5min. :bell:
jen: tagging product: @pm-lead — FYI release notes posted: https://intranet/releases/2026-03-21-heartbeat (will add changelog).
maria: quick Q — are we pinning model-serving to v1.14 as well? devin?
devin: yes pinned model-serving v1.14 in manifest. No hotpatch expected.
samir: ok starting watch. I'll mark holdpoints in the runbook. If p95 hits >250ms for two consecutive holds we pause and assess. Plan is to revert to 0% then run a postmortem if we rollback.
jen: thanks all. I'll be on-call during the window. :coffee:
